description: Main + quickadd window permissions - minimal set, extend deliberately. Window perms: custom titlebar (decorations:false) needs drag + minimize/maximize/close; hide for the Summon toggle and closing quickadd; position/size/monitors for window-state persistence. Global-shortcut: Summon / Global Quick Add / optional Pinned+Search registration. Event: the quickadd window hands new todos to main. Updater+process: signed live updates with relaunch.
